editorial.blurb: A stunning café in Millennium Park with soaring glass ceilings and L-train views, serving exceptional coffee, fresh bakery items, and thoughtfully prepared breakfast dishes.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early to snag outdoor seating for prime train-watching while enjoying your coffee—the elevated tracks pass by every few minutes, and it's the highlight for many visitors.

topDishes.note: Rich, bold, and unforgettable—reviewers say it rivals what they've had in Turkey itself
Beautifully composed with great balance of textures and fresh, flavorful ingredients
Packed with ingredients, nice kick, and made with evident care
